summary: Restless, pulling at brief, ate little at dinner. Vitals normal, afebrile. Redirection and acetaminophen for possible discomfort. Daughter Maria reiterated no hospital transfer unless comfort cannot be achieved.
Drinking about half of usual fluids. Afebrile, BP 122/70. Encourage fluids every hour while awake, recheck vitals in the morning, PCP to review.
No fall. Knee pain after pivot transfer, full range of motion, bearing weight. Acetaminophen, mobile x-ray next morning was negative.
